notes.note: Checked the repair prompt against qualification-repair.mjs and qualification-repair.yml: repair-context.json, base, issue and claim flow are unchanged; the prepare step now also downloads manifests and writes a failure classification into the report, and only enforce mode lets a known-only run skip opening an episode. Re-read against the qualification failure manifest change: the Vitest corpus runner, phase driver and e2e suite write a structured failure manifest only when STATION_QUALIFICATION_MANIFEST_DIR is set, corpus and Android jobs upload it on failure, and the repair and health trackers classify red runs from it in report mode unless STATION_QUALIFICATION_SIGNAL is enforce. No test selection, verdict, permission or release behaviour changes. This document makes no claim about those behaviors; no prose change needed.
